Always returns 1.

Convert the computed float to a byte via CRTFtol and store into the low byte of a3.
Dispatch the transformed byte value with dispatch code 1 via ConditionalDispatch_6bd0.
Dispatch the data payload at v3+8 with a length taken from header bits (*(_DWORD*)v3 >> 8) & 0x3FF via ConditionalDispatch_6bd0.
Return 1 (success) regardless of whether the transformed-byte branch was taken.
